name: Flight 2
summary: All 33 Raptor engines on Booster 9 burned through ascent and Starship performed its first hot-staging separation. The booster exploded during its boostback burn about 3.5 minutes after liftoff, at roughly 90 km over the Gulf of Mexico, which SpaceX traced to filter blockages in the liquid oxygen supply. Ship 25 became the first Starship to reach space, peaking near 148 to 149 km, but a leak during a planned liquid oxygen vent caused fires and the autonomous flight safety system destroyed it about 8 minutes into flight.
highlights: All 33 booster engines ran through ascent
Booster 9 exploded during boostback over the Gulf
Ship 25 was the first Starship to reach space
Ship terminated near 150 km altitude after a vent-related fire

objectives.label: Ship full-duration burn to planned trajectory
objectives.note: Ship lost shortly before planned engine cutoff.

objectives.label: Ship reentry and Pacific splashdown near Hawaii

boosterFate: Exploded during the boostback burn over the Gulf of Mexico at about 90 km (around T+3:21).
shipFate: Destroyed by its autonomous flight safety system near 150 km altitude after a fire cut communications (around T+8:05).

sources.title: Super Heavy-Starship climbs high but falls short on second test flight
